memory_table.semantics: Source-labelled averaged CPM from two title-labelled records per group; no recoverable per-replicate variance or effective biological n inferred.
memory_table.eligible: Point description of the four WT group averages with disclosed offset sensitivity; no genotype screen, confidence interval or independent replication.

rna2020.source_timing: Control versus 24-hour RNA groups only; early ChIP time points are not RNA or ATAC time points.
rna2020.eligible: Assay-specific endpoint counts qualified structurally; not an early-to-late RNA trajectory or a matched temporal multi-assay panel.

exclusions: GSE115502 muscle-injury RNA is a different source context and is not substituted for cultured memory RNA.
Superseries/subseries duplicates are one source lineage, not extra replication.
Chromatin BEDGRAPH/bigWig files are normalized signals, not qualified common-region raw counts; no large raw archives acquired.
No cross-assay preparation pairing or within-condition independence is manufactured from repeated rep labels.
